title: His Dream Date Turned Him Into a Ghoul

cuts.voiceover_text: A shy bookworm thinks he has landed a dream date with the perfect girl. But walking her home is the deadliest mistake of his life. As night falls across Tokyo, Rize shivers and claims she is terrified of local ghoul attacks. Completely smitten, Ken Kaneki gallantly steps forward and promises to protect her.

Led into a secluded alley, Kaneki thinks romance is finally blooming. Rize pulls him into a tender embrace and whispers into his ear. Then, her teeth sink violently into his shoulder. Kaneki freezes in sheer agony. Rize grins with sadistic delight as her eye turns pitch-black and crimson. Four monstrous predatory tentacles burst from her back. She is the city's notorious binge-eating ghoul.

Trapped under a construction site, Kaneki is hunted like prey. But just as Rize corners him for the final feast, heavy steel beams crash down from above, crushing her instantly. Kaneki is rushed to the hospital barely clinging to life. Desperate to save the dying boy, the lead surgeon orders an emergency organ transplant. He implants Rize's organs directly into Kaneki's mangled body.

Discharged back to his apartment, Kaneki expects a normal recovery. Instead, horror sets in. A burger given by his best friend tastes like rancid sludge, forcing him to gag in repulsion. On the television, an expert delivers a chilling reality check: ghouls have mutated taste buds that make human food repulsive, leaving them able to digest only human flesh. Kaneki breaks into a cold sweat.

Refusing to accept the impossible, Kaneki scrambles for proof. He grabs a sharp kitchen knife and plunges it directly into his stomach. The steel blade immediately bends and snaps against his impenetrable skin without leaving a scratch. He is terrified. The nightmare is undeniably real.

Starving and desperate, Kaneki stumbles through the rainy streets. Suddenly, an intoxicating, sweet aroma fills the air, smelling just like his mother's home cooking. He races frantically into an alley to find the source. But when he turns the corner, relief turns to pure revulsion. The appetizing meal is a mutilated human corpse being devoured in the shadows.

Another ghoul named Touka steps in and confronts him. Kaneki sobs uncontrollably, refusing to kill or surrender his humanity. But his body is starving. Touka loses her patience, grabs a severed chunk of flesh, and forces it straight down Kaneki's throat. His date with a ghoul has sealed his fate forever.
